section.label: Library
section.description: Browse characters, Machines of War, NPCs, and Guild Raid Bosses

machinesOfWar.label: Machines of War
machinesOfWar.description: Browse Machine of War details and stats

collections.raidBossesNoRecords: Guild Raid Bosses are not available in the catalog yet.
collections.detailUnavailable: Detailed {{name}} pages aren't available yet — check back soon.

shops.label: Daily Shops
shops.description: Browse what each daily shop can offer on any day of the week

shops.title: Daily Shops
shops.subtitle: Every slot each daily shop can offer on the selected day
shops.randomSlotHint: Only one of these will be offered on this day

day.title: Pick a day
day.content: Choose any day of the week to see what the shops rotate in that day.

shop.title: Pick a shop
shop.content: Switch between the Guild, Guild War, Crusade, and Rogue Trader shops.

random.title: Random slots
random.content: A “N possible rewards” card means the slot is randomized — only one of the listed rewards is actually offered that day.

raidBosses.noSeasonReference: No raid-boss season data is available.
raidBosses.noEncounterData: No season encounter data for this unit.

bosses.title: Guild Raid Bosses
bosses.content: Every guild raid boss. Pick one to see its stats, abilities, and encounter modifiers.

primes.title: Primes
primes.content: The prime enemies fought alongside each boss — browsable in their own right.

progression.title: Progression step
progression.content: Step through the boss's progression ladder to see how its stats scale.

primeModifiers.title: Prime modifiers
primeModifiers.content: For each prime fought alongside this boss, the modifiers that activate as its HP drops.

adjustedStats.title: Adjusted stats
adjustedStats.content: Pick an HP-lost point for each prime to see the boss's stats, abilities, and field enemies once those modifiers activate.

tabs.title: Guild Raid Boss views
tabs.content: Switch between season configurations, current Meta recommendations, and individual boss or prime details.

season.title: Choose a season
season.content: Choose the season configuration whose tiers and encounter sets you want to inspect.

seasonBoard.title: Season encounters
seasonBoard.content: Tiers contain encounter sets. Select a boss or prime to inspect that exact fight.

seasonContent.title: Tier encounter sets
seasonContent.content: Review each tier and set, including its chest, Guild XP, encounters, and turn limit.

metaRecommendations.title: Meta recommendations
metaRecommendations.content: Compare the recommended and alternate hero lineups for each Guild Raid Boss.

metaFilter.title: Filter by Comp
metaFilter.content: Narrow the recommendations and Comp guidance to a specific team archetype.

metaGuidance.title: Comp guidance
metaGuidance.content: Expand a Comp to see its signature unit, core and flex heroes, and suitable Machines of War.

raidBosses.noPrimeModifiers: No prime modifiers for this boss.
raidBosses.noActiveModifiers: No modifiers active at this point.
raidBosses.syncFailed: Couldn't load Guild Raid Bosses. The catalog may still be syncing.
raidBosses.unavailable: Guild Raid Boss data is not available in the catalog yet.

meta.unavailable: Guild Raid Boss Meta is not available yet.
meta.failed: Couldn't load Guild Raid Boss Meta.

npcs.title: NPCs
npcs.noMatchingNpcs: No NPCs match the current filters.
npcs.noMatchingVariation: None of this NPC’s variations match the current filters.
npcs.loadFailed: NPC data could not be loaded.

filters.title: Filter the roster
filters.content: Search by name, or narrow the list by faction, damage type, and trait. An NPC stays listed while any of its variations matches.

list.title: Pick an NPC
list.content: Every non-playable unit in the game, one entry per unit. Variations of the same unit are grouped under it.

picker.title: Pick an NPC
picker.content: Open the picker and search for a unit. Variations of the same unit are grouped under one entry.

variation.title: Variation
variation.content: The game spawns the same unit with different level ladders per mode — Survival, Legendary Hero Events, campaigns. Switch between them here.

level.title: NPC level
level.content: Step through the levels the unit appears at to see its stats at each rank and star count.

stats.title: Stats, attacks, and traits
stats.content: Health, armour, damage, and movement at the selected level, plus the unit’s attacks and traits.
